verdict.rationale: New Relic documents NerdGraph, a GraphQL API for querying its data, and NRQL, a SQL-like query language, as the programmatic way to reach its telemetry. An official MCP server connects external AI tools to the platform and turns plain-English questions into NRQL. The CLI fetches data for troubleshooting and outputs JSON by default, so an external agent can query production data through documented interfaces. Missing for 10: trace querying through the API is never shown explicitly (traces appear only in log-management prose), the MCP server's tool scope is not documented in depth, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents debugging with these APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an external agent query metrics, logs, and traces through documented APIs to debug production

citations.quote: NerdGraph is our GraphQL-format API that lets you query New Relic data and configure some New Relic features.
Ask questions in plain English, and the MCP server converts them to NRQL to get results—even if you're not a NRQL expert.
This update provides a standardized, scalable way to connect your favorite AI development tools directly to the rich context of the New Relic platform
Be it fetching data from your laptop while troubleshooting an issue, or adding New Relic into your CI/CD pipeline.
New Relic Query Language (NRQL) is a SQL-like language for querying your New Relic data.
